label: SIMULATED FlyWire brain -> male nerve cord -> FlyMimic leg, depth of reach

F0_the_grooming_neurons_answer_antennal_.test: mean rate of FlyWire DNg62 and DNge078 under JO-CE above that under sugar and under no drive; if not, F1-F4 are uninterpretable

F1_antennal_input_reaches_deepest.test: median minimum distance under JO-CE at least 0.2 mm below the sugar and no-drive medians (r_full 20 Hz)

F2_the_front_leg_is_the_one_that_moves.test: front > middle, front > hind, front(JO-CE) > front(sugar)

F3_the_activation_scale_does_not_decide_.test: F1's test holds at r_full 10 Hz and 40 Hz

F4_the_reach_runs_through_the_grooming_n.test: median minimum distance with aDN1 and aDN2 removed at least 0.2 mm above the intact JO-CE median
